content.comment_body: Hello everyone, hope you are having a good day. Is it possible to remove the hardware image from the login page of the [product_name] webserver? If anyone has experience, please share your knowledge. Thank you.
May I ask what prompted your question?

I'm not aware of any solution for this. It seems unlikely, as the feature appears to be part of the device's firmware. Which webserver are you using? Is it the basic version showing only the device display, or the extended version for user-created websites?

Hello, starting from [version_no] ([article_no]) and with [product_name] V[version_no], you can create a custom login page. In this setup, the default hardware image is not displayed, and only the login component appears, allowing you to add your own images. To do this in your project, right click and select "Create Login Page". Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to know if it's possible to remove the default hardware image from the [product_name] webserver login page to allow for personalization. Initial replies mentioned the limitation due to firmware, but further input revealed that newer versions support custom login pages where users can choose their own images.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to remove or replace the default hardware image on the [product_name] webserver login page, aiming for increased personalization.
